name: nanoMuse
description: Run an open-source personal agent on your phone, desktop and browser that does tasks across devices, asks before risky actions and remembers you, with a relay you can self-host.

skills.name: Cross-Device Tasks
skills.description: Sends a task from one device to another, such as from the phone to a Mac, with approvals returned to the device in hand.

skills.name: Screen Hands
skills.description: Operates phone apps and computer windows through their screens for tasks that have no API, handing logins back to you.

skills.name: Routines and Goals
skills.description: Checks goals on a schedule and runs routines while the app is closed, including a feed written each morning.

skills.name: Chat App Replies
skills.description: Answers in Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and Telegram as the same agent with the same memory.
